quests.title: Whispers by the Hearth

dialogue.t: Come to think of it, I wasn't the most attentive host when you visited Snezhnaya before.
There's no need for that, Lady Sandrone. Even if we never sat down for a chat, you always provided us with the best refreshments.
*sigh* My apologies. I was too busy back then. I'll be sure to take better care of you the next time you visit.
Mm. You never let me try out your inventions before, either.
There were different reasons for that...
Hmph...
Actually, Father told us not to disturb you wherever possible.
Don't worry about that, I don't mind the occasional disturbance. You can come for tea whenever you feel like it.
Really? A—Actually... I've always wanted to ask you to take a look at Pers... I have some ideas for improvements that I'd like to run past you.
Sure thing, that is my area of expertise, after all.
...Thank you, Lady Sandrone!
Mm. Is being a Harbinger really so tough?
When you put it like that... I suppose it is a little. There's a lot to consider. Though most of my frustrations stem from my colleagues...
So that must mean... that getting along with others is a must-have skill?
I suppose so... But I doubt you have much to worry about in that regard. At least, Lyney certainly doesn't.
Haha, you flatter me, Lady Sandrone.
Do you want to be a Harbinger? Actually... Never mind. It's not my place to ask. Just pretend I said nothing.
Hmm... That's all a little far off for me. I'm certainly in no rush to think about it yet.
If you became a Harbinger, wouldn't that mean you'd have no time to accompany us on missions?
In that case... Would that mean... Lynette and I would have to become Harbingers, too?
I told you, stuff like that is too far off to think about!
Besides, no matter where I go, I'll never leave you two behind. I promise.
Hah... Sometimes I really envy this little family you have.
Thank you for your hospitality, Lady Sandrone.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright, take care.

quests.description: Go to Hotel Bouffes d’ete, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
